name: genshin-mods
description: Six Claude Code mods, each switched by its own command: five under one band above the prompt, waypoints (the next steps, one press each), resin (cache, context, limits and cost, with warm, compact and a one-click handoff), veil (recording mode), commission (a goal's task list and clock), ward (a question before editing a file another session just changed, and a refusal of a git command over the whole index while another session shares the checkout), and pulse (the machine watcher). Two guards run in every session without a command: a delegation guard that nudges a run of lookups toward a haiku agent, and a disk-scan guard that refuses a Bash scan from a root or home folder.
